feature_audit.focus: Audit app routes, identify missing pages, broken links, and incomplete user flows
feature_audit.details: Implemented missing production-grade 404 Not Found page with recovery links, error.tsx runtime exception boundary, interactive Curriculum Roadmap View (/courses/dsa/roadmap), Cheatsheets Hub (/courses/dsa/cheatsheets) covering all 24 modules, and full-stack Settings & Preferences page (/settings). Linked all pages across Header, module overviews, and course hubs with 100% test pass rate.

marketing_overhaul.focus: Audit landing page, marketing copy, feature spotlights, value propositions, and syllabus hooks
marketing_overhaul.details: Sharpened hero value propositions, upgraded 9 feature verb spotlights with developer-first micro-copy, refined authentic learner testimonials, elevated FAQ answers, added high-converting feature highlight strip to course hub, and updated footer branding.

ui_polish.focus: Eliminate boxiness and visual fatigue, polish micro-interactions, enforce token discipline
ui_polish.details: Eliminated nested box-in-box structures and heavy borders across problem accordion, catalog problem cards, and complexity panels. Replaced badge soup with elegant metadata rows. Tokenized transitions across problem workspace, quizzes, landing CTA buttons, audio/video controls, and links. Enforced strict design token purity (replaced text-white with text-on-pop, corrected bare rounded utility in cheatsheets). 100% token test and full test suite passing.

visual_assets.focus: Identify visual asset gaps across course overviews and cheatsheets, generate 3D illustrations
visual_assets.details: Generated 2 high-converting 3D marketing illustrations: banner-cheatsheets.jpg (cybernetic holographic data-tablets, O(1)/O(n) complexity formulas, violet/cyan trap crystals) and banner-roadmap.jpg (futuristic 5-stage holographic skill tree linked by emerald/gold/cyan laser conduits). Integrated seamlessly into the hero headers of /courses/dsa/cheatsheets and /courses/dsa/roadmap.
